title: Thesium never decides, the model directs
chose: A frontier model as the director, with Thesium rendering, measuring and checking

over.name: A template-driven generator
over.why: Every film would look the same and the person could not shape it.

over.name: A visual editor the person drives
over.why: The promise is that a short request becomes a finished film.

because: The craft comes from the model. Thesium's job is to give it a real environment and a strict gate to pass.
tradeoff: The film depends on a model session, so a usage limit or a closed terminal can stop it mid-way.
